# load packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library (ggthemes)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)
```

# import data and organize
```{r}
data <- read_csv("survey_data.csv")

data <- data %>% filter(typeoftrial == "survey")

data <- data %>% select(6, 7, 23, 24, 27)

data <- data %>% separate(trialcondition, into =c("condition", "item"), sep="_")

data <- data %>% separate(response, into = c("label", "response"), sep = ":")

data <- data %>% mutate(response=parse_number(response))

data <- data %>% select(!c(1,4))

data <- data %>% mutate(rt = as.numeric(rt))

data <- data %>% mutate("logRT" = log10(rt))

data <- data %>% mutate(item = as.character(item))
```

```{r}
data %>% pull(subject) %>% unique()

## N = 54

data <- data %>% ungroup()
subj_means <- data %>% group_by(subject, condition) %>% summarise(mean = mean(response))
```












# Group Differences
```{r}
data_long <- data_long %>% mutate(value = as.numeric(value))

##subject and condition means, sd, sem
subject_means <- data_long %>% group_by(ResponseId, condition) %>% summarise(subj_mean = mean(value))

condition_data <- subject_means %>% group_by(condition) %>% summarise(mean_response = mean(subj_mean), sd=sd(subj_mean))
n= subject_means %>% group_by(ResponseId) %>% n_groups() 
condition_data <- condition_data %>% mutate(SEM = sd/sqrt(n))

## Plot and ANOVA
condition_data %>%  ggplot(aes(x=condition, y=mean_response)) + geom_col(position = "dodge") +  labs(x="object squashability", y="squashable rating (1-not at all -- 5-extremely)", title = "Squashable ratings of experimental item conditions") + geom_errorbar(aes(ymin= (mean_response - SEM), ymax= (mean_response + SEM)), width=.25, position=position_dodge(width=0.9)) + theme_economist_white() + scale_fill_economist()

subject_means %>% group_by(condition) %>% shapiro_test(subj_mean)

subject_outliers <- subject_means %>% group_by(condition) %>% identify_outliers(subj_mean)
extreme_subject_outliers <- subject_outliers %>% filter(is.extreme=="TRUE")
subjects_trimmed <- subject_means %>% filter(!ResponseId %in% extreme_outliers)

subjects_trimmed <- subjects_trimmed %>% ungroup() 


get_anova_table(RManova)
```

# t-tests
```{r}
U <- data_long %>% filter(condition == "U")
S <- data_long %>% filter(condition == "S")

Uitem_mean <- U %>% group_by(item) %>% summarize(mean_item = mean(value))
Sitem_mean <- S %>% group_by(item) %>% summarize(mean_item = mean(value))

shapiro.test(Uitem_mean$mean_item)
shapiro.test(Sitem_mean$mean_item)

ggqqplot(Uitem_mean$mean_item, ylab = "value",
         ggtheme = theme_minimal())
ggqqplot(Sitem_mean$mean_item, ylab = "value",
         ggtheme = theme_minimal())

uttest <- t.test(Uitem_mean$mean_item, mu = 3, alternative = "less")
sttest <- t.test(Sitem_mean$mean_item, mu = 3, alternative = "greater")

uttest
sttest

before <- Uitem_mean$mean_item
after <- Sitem_mean$mean_item

UxSttest = t.test(before,after, paired = TRUE)
UxSttest




```
